edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC8 Caller without Case record U on either operation (exception X2)
    Given the caller does not hold Case record U of the operation
    When the caller calls either of the two operations
    Then the caller gets 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read, nothing changes and no record is written

  Scenario: AC9 Service level read from the package (exception X6)
    Given the deviation is in DEV_WITH_OWNER and its time there exceeds the service level read from the DEVIATIONS package in force
    When the service level is breached
    Then the case escalates to the team manager, the breach is reported and the state does not change

  Scenario: AC10 Boundary reach by a test (exception X9)
    Given a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row, a timer row or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC11 Architecture rules of section 8 (BR1 to BR11)
    Given the story is built
    When the component and boundary tests run
    Then only rwb_deviation writes the deviation table, the decision is recorded before any change, no cross-schema join or foreign key exists, and no person name, identity number or case fact is copied into rwb_deviation

  Scenario: AC12 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given a caller calls one of the two operations with a credential or a deviation that the contract refuses
    When the operation answers
    Then the answer is the status code of the operation's contract among 401, 403 or 404, and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC13 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key
    Given a write has been accepted with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with the same key
    Then the first answer is returned again and no second row, record or event is written

  Scenario: AC14 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an activity of section 12 is retried or times out
    When the retry runs
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written and no move is answered

  Scenario: AC15 Consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given a consumed contract fails or does not answer inside 2 s
    When the step calls it
    Then nothing is written, no move is answered and the caller sees 503

  Scenario: AC16 Disallowed status change
    Given a deviation is in a state from which section 8 does not allow the event of the status change
    When the status change is requested
    Then the change is refused and nothing is written
